A furry, [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Species/Legends|species]] lived in the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]. One eyepatch wearing member of this species was present at a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] on [[Keyorin]] when [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]], and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] visited.<ref name="Marvel85" /> A representative of this species was also present at the [[First Conference of Free Peoples]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].<ref name="Marvel90" />
